title: MTRAGEval: Evaluating Multi-Turn RAG Conversations
description: SemEval-2026 Task 8 (MTRAGEval): evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in multi-turn conversations, built on the MTRAG benchmark. Given a conversation, the retrieved reference passages, and a system-generated response, annotators judge how faithful the response is to the passages, how well it answers the user's latest question, and whether it correctly handles unanswerable, underspecified, non-standalone, or unclear questions. The shared task covers retrieval (A), generation (B), and full RAG (C).
paperReference: Rosenthal et al., SemEval 2026 (Task 8); built on the MTRAG benchmark (Katsis et al., 2025)
